How green is each ward of Trichy, and how much greener can it get?

Ward-by-ward tree canopy and vegetation from Sentinel-2 satellite imagery (Feb–Apr 2026), population from GHS-POP 2025, and the land still free to plant, found by removing buildings, roads, water, farmland, the airport and railway land. Tap a ward for its locality names, numbers and a greening plan.

Ward ranking

Zone summary

Canopy potential assumes the planting shares described under "How this was measured". Figures are area-weighted across each zone's wards.

How this was measured

Tree canopy is land that ESA WorldCover 2021 maps as trees, or that shows NDVI ≥ 0.5 in the 2026 dry-season Sentinel-2 composite, excluding farmland, water and building footprints. Vegetation cover is the wider share with NDVI ≥ 0.3, which includes grass and crops.

Population is the GHS-POP 2025 estimate (JRC, 100 m grid) summed inside each ward, 12.2 lakh in all. Census 2011 counted 8.47 lakh when the city had 60 wards, so treat ward figures as modelled estimates.

Plantable space is each 10 m pixel left after removing Microsoft building footprints, OSM roads (buffered to their width), water, farmland, existing canopy, and the airport, railway, military land and sports grounds. Only patches of 0.1 ha or more count. Smaller scraps are mostly paved yards and unmapped roofs.

Planting assumptions

40% of open land becomes canopy (50% inside school, hospital, college and temple campuses). 30% of grass and scrub is converted to trees. One tree per 25 m² of planted land.

Street trees go only where no canopy lies within about 15 m of the road: every 10 m on one side of main roads, every 15 m on residential streets, or every 20 m in wards where buildings cover more than 35% of the land. Each mature street tree adds about 30 m² of canopy.

Ward numbers and names. Boundaries are the OpenStreetMap ward relations. Their zone groupings match the Corporation's councillor list for Zone 1. Locality names are OSM place names inside each ward, or the nearest ones where none fall inside, so they are indicative. Some localities may carry a different number in property-tax records. Check the Corporation ward map before citing a ward by number.
